label: 0018 · Starter, 50 km BEL cut, remeshed BEL sheet with full prior, CMT catalog through May 2025, UNR positions (exploratory MCMC)
description: starter_belcut50_remesh_m99_unr (0015) with the GCMT catalog extended through May 2025. The 2025-01-13 Hyuga-nada Mw 6.8 step (35-48 mm at the Miyazaki stations) is now removed. Before, it stayed in the Jan-May 2025 window and, through the continuous trajectory fit, also inflated the Aug-Dec 2024 one: the post-Hyuga-nada speed-up at 960715 was 84 mm/yr and is now 50. Residual RMS within 100 km of the epicenter drops from 22 to 6 mm/yr in Aug-Dec 2024 and from 72 to 7.5 mm/yr in 2025, and the network-wide fit in 2025 improves by 45%. All other windows are unchanged. Nankai's -2 afterslip floor still binds after the 2024 Hyuga-nada earthquake, spreading afterslip over about 26,000 km2 from 1 to 47 km depth.
